mainEntity.name: What does finish carpentry installation actually include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry installation usually covers the interior details that make a space look complete, such as baseboards, crown molding, door casings, window trim, wainscoting, and built-ins. For homes in Denver and nearby areas, the right scope depends on whether you want a cosmetic upgrade, a repair, or a custom built-in solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry installation typically includes baseboards, crown molding, door and window casing, trim, wainscoting, and custom built-ins. The exact scope depends on whether you need new trim, replacements, or custom woodwork.
